$comment: Copy to config/seats.json and edit. Every seat = one Hyper-V VM = one player.

gpu.$comment: Leave instancePath empty to use the first partitionable GPU. List them with Test-HostReadiness.ps1.

viewer.$comment: Program that shows a seat's screen on a host monitor. Placeholders: {address} {width} {height} {fps} {seat}

tools.$comment: Optional: NirSoft SoundVolumeView.exe, used to send each viewer's sound to that seat's headset.

$inputModes.router: Host keeps the USB devices. SeatRouter (Interception driver) sends each keyboard/mouse to its seat. Works on Windows 10/11 Pro.
$inputModes.usb-dda: A whole PCIe USB controller card is passed to the VM (set usbControllerLocationPath). Windows Server only. Headset mic works.
$inputModes.usbip: Individual USB devices shared to the VM over the virtual network with usbip-win2 / VirtualHere. Headset mic works.
$inputModes.viewer: No routing: the viewer window (Moonlight/Parsec) gets whatever input the host gives it. Good for one seat + host.
